handoff: No blocking findings. AC1 met: bun test 1229 pass, typecheck clean, no fixture changed, all replaced literals byte-identical. findings.title: Usage and dynamic command hints stay literal outside cmd
findings.detail:
These strings are still spelled literally: usage do_instead hints at mode.ts:20, answer.ts:31, status.ts:49, done.ts:80/86 and why.ts:170/176; dynamic hints built from the command name at cli.ts:37 (`norn ${c.name} --help`), runtime/args.ts:21, human.ts:196/247/334 and agent-unit.ts:70 (reportCommand); the echo in runtime/cockpit.ts:46 verbMessage; and the `norn init` next step in help.ts:71 and orient rules 170-171. Most fall under the stated exceptions (self-usage, D1; dynamic verb). The help.ts:71 next step and reportCommand are borderline against the goal line 'Every command string norn prints … doctor/init next steps'.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Slice 14 should grep for these locations when it renames. Optionally route help.ts:71 through cmd.init().

findings.title: B7 cited without the story qualifier
findings.detail:
The comment in commands.ts and the header of printed-commands.test.ts cite 'B7'. In .agents/PRD.md, B7 is 'Launch unknown'. The id meant is the gh-75 story spec's B7.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Write 'gh-75 B7' or similar.

findings.title: Builders do not escape quoted text, and flags are sometimes appended outside the builder
findings.detail:
cmd.answer and cmd.stuck wrap their text in quotes without escaping, while q() in the same file does escape. Every current caller passes a literal, so nothing breaks today. Some flags are appended outside the builder: apply.ts `${cmd.unstick()} --to` and agent-unit.ts `${cmd.approve(key)} (or --reject)`. norn() also drops '' arguments, but no caller passes one.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Escape the text, or accept only literal text. Fold the trailing flags into the builder options when slice 14 renames.

findings.title: Import order
findings.detail:
In cli.ts the @norn/core import comes after the local imports. In view/src/load.ts:9, cmd is out of alphabetical order.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Move the import to match the surrounding files.
